• ε ≈ 0.2 (typical)
• Range: [0.8, 1.2]
• Too big? Clip it!

Prevents wild gradient jumps!" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=12;fontColor=#94a3b8;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="430" y="475" width="240" height="95" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="comp3-bg" value="" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1e293b;strokeColor=#10b981;strokeWidth=2;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="720" y="390" width="280" height="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="comp3-header" value=" Advantage (A)" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#10b981;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="720" y="400" width="280" height="25" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="comp3-formula" value="Reward - Baseline" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=#064e3b;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=1;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#f1f5f9;fontFamily=Courier New;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="740" y="435" width="240" height="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="comp3-desc" value="How much better than average?

• A > 0: Better than expected
• A < 0: Worse than expected
• A = 0: As expected

Reduces variance in training!" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=12;fontColor=#94a3b8;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="740" y="475" width="240" height="95" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="comp4-bg" value="" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1e293b;strokeColor=#06b6d4;strokeWidth=2;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="1030" y="390" width="280" height="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="comp4-header" value=" KL Penalty (β)" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#06b6d4;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="1030" y="400" width="280" height="25" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="comp4-formula" value="-β × KL(π ‖ π_ref)" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=#164e63;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=1;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#f1f5f9;fontFamily=Courier New;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="1050" y="435" width="240" height="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="comp4-desc" value="Stay close to reference model.

• β ≈ 0.05 (typical)
• KL = "distance" measure
• π_ref = SFT model

Don't drift too far away!" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=12;fontColor=#94a3b8;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="1050" y="475" width="240" height="95" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="insight-bg" value="" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1e293b;strokeColor=#8b5cf6;strokeWidth=3;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="250" y="620" width="900" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="insight-title" value="KEY INSIGHT" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#8b5cf6;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="340" y="630" width="790" height="25" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="insight-text" value="Every extra term in PPO exists to PREVENT OVERFITTING. multiply probability by advantage.
